status: DRAFT - NOT IN FORCE. Not under run/discovery/config/, read by no code. Becomes a prereg only when the user approves, the open_decisions are answered, and the file is committed with its sha256 BEFORE window_start.
note: Drafted 2026-10-21 after ADR 0022 (power audit). Goal: raise power WITHOUT loosening any criterion: a longer, forward, never-seen window; one pooled basket test instead of per-symbol intersection; fewer members. Every number below that is a statistical criterion (alpha, one-sided StepM, min events) is the same as promo-v3 / IW1 v1 or stricter.

window.kind: forward (data does not exist yet, so nothing can have been read)
window.warmup: indicator warmup data from BEFORE window_start may be read; entries only inside the window; exits at or before window_end
window.single_look: evaluated ONCE after window_end. No interim evaluation, no peeking at member P&L inside the window. Paper replays or live monitoring of the same members are forbidden to be used for decisions on this family.
window.extension_option: 24 months (window_end 2028-10-31) is the same design with the power in power_table.length_24m; choosing it is open decision D1.

basket.rule: BTC, ETH and the first 13 further symbols of the market-cap order below that have a Binance USD-M perpetual with >=180 days of history at window_start. Fixed in this file; a symbol that stops trading is kept with zero return afterwards (no survivorship repair).
basket.note: HYPE excluded (history <180 d may apply at start; re-check at freeze).

members.rule: first 5 of pipeline.validation_candidates() of a DEV-only evolve state directory, frozen to a members file (ids, canonical specs, context, sha256) before window_start. Each rule is applied to every basket symbol. Same exclusions as IW1 v1.
members.entry_bar: a member must show DEV annual SR >= 1.0 on the IW1 statistic (basket average, assumed_public_v1) in the 2021-2025 DEV stretches (ADR 0019 tool) before it is frozen; below that the window is not worth spending.
members.bundle_option: a single bundle of the 5 as ONE hypothesis (PR #20 draft) is open decision D3; default is 5 hypotheses.

cost.measured_alt_cost: open decision D2: if an alt order-book estimate (criteria v2, ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA) is sealed BEFORE window_end and BEFORE any member result is computed, the user may switch to it by amending this file in writing; default stays assumed_public_v1.

test.statistic: per member, equal-weight average over basket symbols of the daily net return series (bp, exit-day booking) on the common UTC-day grid of the window
test.method: Romano-Wolf StepM (stats_mc.stepm), H0 mean <= 0, one-sided - unchanged
test.alpha_note: same spending as IW1 v1: stats_mc.spending_alpha(1, 0.05). A second window of this family would get spending_alpha(2, 0.05). The 0.05 is shared with nothing else: this is a NEW family; history-wide FWER of the BTC/ETH family is not touched.
test.bootstrap_B_why: ADR 0022 side finding: with B=1000 the critical value cannot go below the max of 1000 draws (effective alpha ~0.001). B >= 20*m/alpha ~ 3300 is needed for alpha/m; 10000 used.
test.pass: StepM rejects H0 AND pooled events >= 60 AND >= 30 non-zero days (unchanged from IW1 v1)
test.beta_report: required in the report, not a gate: OLS beta of each member's daily series on the equal-weight basket buy-and-hold, and the beta-hedged mean. Open decision D4 makes the beta-hedged mean > 0 (same alpha) a second gate; it lowers power.

single_use: RESERVED marker + window key appended to validation_window_history.jsonl before any member is evaluated; same mechanism as independent_window.py

power_table.method: normal approximation, same as ADR 0016/0017; bounds K=1 (best) and K=m=5 Bonferroni (worst); StepM lies between. Assumes the same annual SR on each symbol and constant edge (upper bound for real edges). Pooling boost sqrt(M/(1+(M-1)rho)), M=15.
power_table.rho_note: crypto daily returns across these symbols correlate ~0.6-0.8 in a market move; rho 0.6 is the realistic row. A signal that is mostly market beta is not helped by pooling and the 12m/rho 0.6 row is the honest one: needs annual SR ~2.2-2.7.

open_decisions.D1: 12 months (result ~2027-11) or 24 months (result ~2028-11)? Recommended: 12 months with the option to register a SECOND window of the same family (alpha spending k=2) rather than extending this one.
open_decisions.D2: keep assumed_public_v1 (default) or switch to a measured alt cost if one is sealed first.
open_decisions.D3: 5 hypotheses (default) or the 5 as one bundle hypothesis (K=1, one more degree of selection).
open_decisions.D4: beta-hedged second gate yes/no. Recommended yes if members are long-only: 2020-type and 2024-type up-markets otherwise pass on beta alone.
open_decisions.D5: who freezes the members file and when (needs a DEV-only evolve run on the then-current code; suggested 2026-10-31).

not_changed: no stats criterion is looser than promo-v3 / IW1 v1; locked TEST, paper and promotion rules (ADR 0009/0010) are unchanged; IW1 stays closed.
